name: usage-bars
description: Colored usage bars above the prompt: context window, 5-hour, weekly and per-model (e.g. Fable) limits, model share and session cost, plus a button for Claude's limit-reset offers. Per-model limits and reset offers are read from Anthropic's internal usage endpoint with your Claude login.

warnAt.title: Yellow from (%)
warnAt.description: A bar turns yellow at this percentage.

dangerAt.title: Red from (%)
dangerAt.description: A bar turns red at this percentage, and an alert pops up here and again at 95%.

alerts.title: Limit alerts
alerts.description: Pop up when a rate limit crosses the red line and 95%.

showCost.title: Show session cost
showCost.description: Show what the session has cost so far.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the per-model limits and reset offers are fetched (at least 30).
